 Watch Portugal vs Denmark in the Nations League for FREE from anywhere as the holders play their first match since the retirement of legendary forward Cristiano Ronaldo. FourFourTwo has all the live stream details and TV channels, wherever you are in the world.
 Ronaldo has dominated the headlines in Portugal since calling time on his extraordinary 23-year international career last week, but attention now returns to Jorge Jesus' side, who need only a point to seal top spot in Group A4.
 Denmark sit second in the table and could guarantee their place in the quarter-finals with a win in Braga. If they can't find those three points today, it will all come down to Tuesday's game against Norway.
 Read on as FourFourTwo brings you all the information on how to watch Portugal vs Denmark online, on TV, and from anywhere.
 Watch Portugal vs Denmark for FREE

 How to watch Portugal vs Denmark in the US 
 Viewers in the US can watch Portugal vs Denmark live on Fox Sports , the official broadcast partner of the Nations League in the States.
 Fox Sports 2 is the place to go to watch the game, which kicks-off at 2:45pm ET.
 The channel is available via cord-cutters such as Sling , YouTube TV , Fubo and DirecTV Stream . Alternatively, in-house streamer Fox One carries FS2, with a 3-day free trial available on the platform.
